source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
To be **eligible to fight**, a unit not yet **selected to fight** in this phase must be **engaged**, have been engaged as the step began, or have charged this turn. Players repeat 2 stages until every eligible unit has fought:

1. **Resolve Fights First Combats**: the active player begins, then players alternate, each selecting 1 of their eligible **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)** units to fight.
2. **Resolve Remaining Combats**: the player who moved the sequence here begins, then players alternate, each selecting any 1 of their eligible units to fight.

If the player due to select cannot:

- in Resolve Fights First Combats, with no eligible **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)** unit left on either side, move to Resolve Remaining Combats, where that player selects next
- in Resolve Remaining Combats, with no eligible unit left on either side, the Fight step is over
- otherwise, the opponent selects next

After each fight in Resolve Remaining Combats, go back to Resolve Fights First Combats if any **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)** unit has become eligible; the non-active player then selects first.

A unit selected to fight resolves 1 **fight type** it is eligible for: Normal Fight, [Overrun Fight](vsdata:core-rule/overrun-fight) or one from another rule.

interpretation.question: Who selects first when returning from Remaining Combats to Fights First?
